mapper.select: SELECT account_id, trading_mode, snapshot_date, total_value, cash_balance, daily_pnl, daily_pnl_rate FROM trading_account_snapshot WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND trading_mode = #{tradingMode} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_account_snapshot (account_id, trading_mode, snapshot_date, total_value, cash_balance, daily_pnl, daily_pnl_rate) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tradingMode}, #{snapshotDate}, #{totalValue}, #{cashBalance}, #{dailyPnl}, #{dailyPnlRate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_value = VALUES(total_value), cash_balance = VALUES(cash_balance), daily_pnl = VALUES(daily_pnl), daily_pnl_rate = VALUES(daily_pnl_rate), deleted_at = NULL
